situation: Reviewing a function with deeply nested if/else validation logic.
chosen: Use guard clauses / early returns; validate and bail at the top, keep the happy path flat.
rejected: Keep nested if/else pyramids and a single return at the bottom.
principle: Flat is better than nested; early returns.

situation: Code builds file paths and reads files.
chosen: Use pathlib.Path exclusively for paths and file IO.
rejected: Use os.path.join and open() with string concatenation.

situation: Debug output and operational visibility in services.
chosen: Use the logging module with structured, leveled messages.
principle: logging, never print, in service code.

chosen: Full type hints on parameters and return types.

situation: Distributed state, caching, replication design discussions.
chosen: State the CAP trade-off explicitly; never silently serve stale writes as authoritative.
principle: Explicit CAP stance; no silent stale-authoritative reads.

situation: Iterating and transforming lists of records.
rejected: Index-based loops appending to preallocated lists.
